# Three.js

Version 0.187.0, MIT license (see LICENSE).

Official npm package: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.187.0.tgz
Package SHA-512 integrity verified before copying three.module.js and three.core.js.

The site serves these ES modules locally. It imports no hosted 3D model, texture, image sequence or video. The car geometry, studio lighting and SVG fallback are authored in car-scene.js.
